## Biographical Information

(1809-1873)

children’s writer and naturalist

She married (8 July 1839) the Rev. Alfred Gatty (1813-1903), Vicar of Ecclesfield; she was the mother of Juliana Horatia (Gatty) Ewing, and a contributor to <i>MP</i> (1857-69).   Gatty’s <i>Aunt Judy’s Tales</i> (1859) and <i>Aunt Judy’s Letters</i> (1862) were made up of contributions to the <i>MP</i> from 1858 to 1865. 'Aunt Judy' was there represented as an older sister telling stories to her younger brothers and sisters, and was based on Gatty’s daughter [Juliana Horatia Gatty](person_494.qmd) (1841-1885), later Ewing, who herself began to contribute to the <i>MP</i> in 1861. In 1866 Gatty began to edit a periodical for George Bell called <i>[Aunt Judy’s Magazine](../organizations/other_54.qmd)</i> and most of the later fiction of both mother and daughter appeared there.
